title: Galaxy Skill Market
summary: Explore a skill catalog as a pearl-like galaxy: enter a category, inspect a skill and try a local installation. An interactive archive of a product interface, with synthetic data and an editable Agent at its center.
highlights: A deterministic sphere layout connects the full catalog to category views through animated transitions.
Custom pearl shading, camera navigation and HTML labels make the catalog spatial and actionable.
Search, skill details, simulated installation and Agent customization work with local demo state.
English and Chinese, light and dark themes, and a mobile list keep the same synthetic catalog accessible.

zh.title: Galaxy 技能星图
zh.summary: 把技能目录变成可探索的珠光星系：进入分类、查看技能，再体验本地模拟安装。这个从产品界面整理出的交互作品使用合成数据，并把可编辑的 Agent 放在星图中心。
highlights: 确定性球体布局通过连续动画连接目录全景与分类视图。
自定义珠光材质、相机导航和 HTML 标签，让技能目录既有空间感，也能直接操作。
搜索、技能详情、模拟安装和 Agent 定制使用独立的本地演示状态。
中英文、明暗主题及移动端列表共用同一份合成技能目录。
